mapper.select: select * from goods where id = #{id} and delete_status = 0
mapper.insert: insert into goods(name, price, brand_id, stock, status, audit_status, audit_remark, image_url, description, owner_id, condition_level, view_count, delete_status) values (#{name}, #{price}, #{brandId}, #{stock}, #{status}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditRemark}, #{imageUrl}, #{description}, #{ownerId}, #{conditionLevel}, #{viewCount}, #{deleteStatus})
mapper.update: update goods set name = #{name}, price = #{price}, brand_id = #{brandId}, stock = #{stock}, status = #{status}, audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, description = #{description}, owner_id = #{ownerId}, condition_level = #{conditionLevel}, view_count = #{viewCount} where id = #{id} and delete_status = 0
update goods set delete_status = 1, status = 0 where id = #{id} and delete_status = 0
